sanskrit_verse:
ज्योतिर् ज्ञानं तथोत्पातमविदित्वा तु ये नृणाम् ।
श्रावयन्त्यर्थलोभेन विनेयास्ते प्रयत्नतः ॥
transliteration: jyotir jñānaṃ tathotpātam aviditvā tu ye nṛṇām | śrāvayanty arthalobhena vineyās te prayatnataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who, without true knowledge of astrological science and omens, instruct others out of greed for wealth—these must be restrained with effort.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from verified knowledge, not mere claim
Causation arises through misrepresentation of sacred sciences
Capacity-based responsibility is tied to authentic realization
Restoration logic demands correction of false instruction
Consciousness alignment requires purity in transmission of dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF an instructor lacks validated knowledge of jyotisha THEN their advisory capacity is nullified UNTIL rectification occurs
IF instruction is motivated by arthalobha THEN it shall trigger automatic review by realized authorities
IF false guidance causes disruption THEN initiate completion protocol for both giver and receiver
supreme_court_application: In the Supreme Court of Dharma, any case involving unverified dispensation of astrological or spiritual knowledge must undergo immediate threshold verification. The court must assess whether the actor possessed valid pramāṇa. If not, a directive for conscious reintegration is issued rather than punitive exclusion.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that incorrect teaching stems from absence of darshanam. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals how misinformation spreads when unchecked by vidya. Responsibility lies in aligning action with witnessed truth. Non-punitive reality rule ensures correction flows as natural consequence, not imposed penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śravaṇa-shuddhi process to cleanse distorted transmissions
Assign supervised learning under qualified preceptor until competency is restored
Implement sākṣātkāra-based validation before future instruction is permitted
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law flows from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Misuse of sacred knowledge disrupts cosmic order; thus, its correction restores dharma. There is no punishment—only realignment with pure consciousness. Dharma is restored.
